summary.text: Genevieve Mina, a Democrat, has represented District 19 in the Alaska House of Representatives, covering Anchorage neighborhoods including Airport Heights, Mountain View and Russian Jack, since 2023.

paragraphs.text: Her legislative biography describes her as the daughter of Filipino immigrants who grew up in her family's assisted living home business, and as a graduate of the University of Alaska Anchorage with a B.A. in political science (2023).
Before holding office she was president of the Alaska Young Democrats from 2019 to 2023 and worked as a legislative aide and as an aide to the Anchorage Assembly.
